Q: How to save a custom software project file A:

System.IO has some Methods to Read and Write your stuff, using things like StreamReader or StreamWriter.

Here is how to save some Text to a file using StreamWriter:

var writer = new StreamWriter("path/to/my/file"); // Creates an object of StreamWriter
writer.WriteLine("Text I want to write");
writer.Close(); // StreamWriter and StreamReader can be created in a using Statement, making manually closing not required.

See here if you need more information: https://www.w3schools.com/cs/cs_files.php

Q: How to specify INSTALL_INTERFACE include path based on target platform in cmake A:

DESTINATION <dir> accepts a single argument but you gave two, one of them is "". It should be a single line

    DESTINATION
        $<$<NOT:$<PLATFORM_ID:QNX>>:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${PROJECT_NAME}/${TARGET_ALIAS_NAME}>$<$<PLATFORM_ID:QNX>:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${TARGET_ALIAS_NAME}>

or

    DESTINATION
        $<IF:$<NOT:$<PLATFORM_ID:QNX>>,${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${PROJECT_NAME}/${TARGET_ALIAS_NAME},${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${TARGET_ALIAS_NAME}>

Or a multiline generator string resulting in a non stripped line (caution, not tested carefully):

    DESTINATION
        "$<$<NOT:$<PLATFORM_ID:QNX>>:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${PROJECT_NAME}/${TARGET_ALIAS_NAME}>
         $<$<PLATFORM_ID:QNX>:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${TARGET_ALIAS_NAME}>"

or

    DESTINATION
        "$<IF:$<NOT:$<PLATFORM_ID:QNX>>,
              ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${PROJECT_NAME}/${TARGET_ALIAS_NAME},
              ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${TARGET_ALIAS_NAME}>"
